column4: Show names, results and bulgarian commanders of the battles with no ships lost in the 'English Channel'.
column5: SELECT name ,  RESULT ,  bulgarian_commander FROM battle EXCEPT SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location  =  'English Channel'
column6: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location != 'English Channel' AND T2.disposition_of_ship = 'sunk'

column4: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
column5: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
column6: SELECT T2.id, T2.name FROM death AS T1 JOIN battle AS T2 ON T1.bulgarian_commander = T2.bulgarian_commander WHERE T1.killed > 10 GROUP BY T2.id, T2.name

column4: What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?
column5: SELECT T1.killed ,  T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage  =  't'
column6: SELECT T1.death, T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id = T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage = 't'

column4: Which distinctive models are produced by maker with the full name General Motors or weighing more than 3500?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;
column6: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM car_makers AS T1 INNER JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.MakeId WHERE T1.FullName = 'General Motors' OR T2.Weight > 3500

column4: What are the names of the singers and number of concerts for each person?
column5: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id GROUP BY T2.singer_id
column6: SELECT T2.Name ,  COUNT(*) FROM singer AS T1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T2.Singer_ID

column4: What are the names of the teachers and the courses they teach in ascending alphabetical order by the name of the teacher?
column5: SELECT T3.Name ,  T2.Course FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID  =  T2.Course_ID JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T3.Teacher_ID ORDER BY T3.Name
column6: SELECT T2.Name, T1.Course FROM course AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID = T2.Course_ID JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T2.Teacher_ID = T3.Teacher_ID ORDER BY T3.Name ASC

column4: What are the ids and names of each document, as well as the number of paragraphs in each?
column5: SELECT T1.document_id ,  T2.document_name ,  count(*) FROM Paragraphs AS T1 JOIN Documents AS T2 ON T1.document_id  =  T2.document_id GROUP BY T1.document_id
column6: SELECT D.Document_ID, D.Document_Name, COUNT(P.Paragraph_ID) AS Number_of_Paragraphs FROM Documents D LEFT JOIN Paragraphs P ON D.Document_ID = P.Document_ID GROUP BY D.Document_ID, D.Document_Name;

column4: Return the different descriptions for templates that have been used in a document.
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T1.template_type_description FROM Ref_template_types AS T1 JOIN Templates AS T2 ON T1.template_type_code  = T2.template_type_code JOIN Documents AS T3 ON T2.Template_ID  =  T3.template_ID
column6: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Template_Description FROM Documents AS T1 INNER JOIN Templates AS T2 ON T1.Template_ID = T2.Template_ID

column4: List each owner's first name, last name, and the size of his for her dog.
column5: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T2.size_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id
column6:
SELECT O.first_name, O.last_name, S.size_description
FROM Owners O
JOIN Dogs D ON O.owner_id = D.owner_id
JOIN Sizes S ON D.size_code = S.size_code;

column4: What are each professional's first name and description of the treatment they have performed?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T3.treatment_type_description FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id JOIN Treatment_types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code  =  T3.treatment_type_code
column6:
SELECT P.first_name, TT.treatment_type_description
FROM Professionals P
JOIN Treatments T ON P.professional_id = T.professional_id
JOIN Treatment_Types TT ON T.treatment_type_code = TT.treatment_type_code;

column4: Find the number of owners who do not own any dogs at this moment.
column5: SELECT count(*) FROM Owners WHERE owner_id NOT IN ( SELECT owner_id FROM Dogs )
column6: SELECT COUNT(owner_id) FROM Owners WHERE owner_id NOT IN (SELECT owner_id FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn = 'N')

column4: What are the names of high schoolers who both have friends and are liked?
column5: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id INTERSECT SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.liked_id  =  T2.id
column6: SELECT T1.name FROM Highschooler AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.student_id JOIN Likes AS T3 ON T1.id  =  T3.student_id

column4: For students who have pets , how many pets does each student have ? list their ids instead of names .

column4: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
column5: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1

column4: Show the property type descriptions of properties belonging to that code.
column5: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code  =  T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code

column4: What are the last name of the students who live in North Carolina but have not registered in any degree programs?
column5: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id
column6: SELECT last_name FROM Students WHERE current_address_id IN ( SELECT address_id FROM Addresses WHERE state_province_county = 'North Carolina' ) AND student_id NOT IN ( SELECT student_id FROM Student_Enrolment );

column4: Find the series name and country of the tv channel that is playing some cartoons directed by Ben Jones and Michael Chang?
column5: SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Michael Chang' INTERSECT SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Ben Jones'
column6:
SELECT TC.series_name, TC.Country 
FROM TV_Channel AS TC 
JOIN Cartoon AS C ON TC.id = C.Channel 
WHERE C.Directed_by IN ('Ben Jones', 'Michael Chang');

column4: What are the African countries that have a  population less than any country in Asia?
column5: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"  AND population  <  (SELECT max(population) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia")
column6: SELECT name FROM country WHERE continent = 'Africa' AND population < ( SELECT MIN(population) FROM country WHERE continent = 'Asia' )

column4: How many official languages does Afghanistan have?
column5: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Name  =  "Afghanistan" AND IsOfficial  =  "T"
column6: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Name = 'Afghanistan' AND T2.IsOfficial = 'Yes';

column4: Return the country codes for countries that do not speak English.
column5: SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage EXCEPT SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE LANGUAGE  =  "English"
column6: SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Code NOT IN ( SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' )

column4: Return the country name and the numbers of languages spoken for each country that speaks at least 3 languages.
column5: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) ,  T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  2
column6: SELECT T1.Name, COUNT(T2.Language) as NumberOfLanguages FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.IsOfficial = 'Yes' GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(T2.Language) >= 3

column4: What are the first names of all players, and their total ranking points?
column5: SELECT sum(ranking_points) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name
column6: SELECT T1.first_name, SUM(T3.ranking_points) as total_ranking_points FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.winner_id JOIN rankings AS T3 ON T1.player_id = T3.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

column4: How many car models are produced in the usa?
column5: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';
column6: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM car_names cn JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Model = ml.Model JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId WHERE c.CountryName = 'USA'
